hooks.text: Legend says an imperial commander cast his sword and the tide vanished.
How did a single sword cast into the sea breach Kamakura?
Seven guarded mountain passes could not save Kamakura from the sea.

title: How Did Kamakura Fall to a Vanishing Tide? 🌊
description: During the 1333 siege of Kamakura, imperial forces bypassed impregnable mountain defenses by exploiting a dramatic coastal low tide.

beats.text: Blocked by wooden shields at the passes, he turned toward the coastal cape.
